  "text": "The constable struck the floor again. Beyond the yellow door, something dragged a heel across the boards.

“Stop copying him,” Ada said.

The scrape ceased. The constable turned his head toward her, but the black line around his finger pulled tight, holding his hand pointed at the stone.

The fingers in the gap wrote a third word on the square: HE.

WAIT UNTIL HE.

“He what?” Elias asked.

The fingers vanished. A knock sounded inside the stone, weak and hurried. Mara glanced over her shoulder. The yellow door gave under her weight, opening a finger’s breadth before Venn hauled it shut.

Ada looked down at the ledger. Beneath the warning, another line was forming: FINISHES.

The constable’s heel rose. Ada caught his ankle before it fell. His boot was dry, but her palm came away black with ink. He stared at it as though he had never seen the boot before.

“Hold him,” she told Elias.

Elias seized the constable’s shoulders. Ada pushed her stained hand into the gap. The stone shifted outward. On the other side, someone gripped her wrist: a hand with a red groove around it.

Venn made a sound behind her. He released the yellow door to look at his own wrist, and Mara cried out as the handle turned beneath her palm.

“Venn!” Ada shouted.

He caught it again. The hand beyond the stone let Ada go and tapped once against her palm.

The constable lowered his heel without striking. For a moment, nothing answered him.

Then the yellow door knocked from their side."
